reference.name: Long label pushes the mobile Label filter menu off the left edge
reference.summary: At phone width, once a repository has a valid long label (up to the 50-character limit), the issue list Label filter dropdown opens leftward and mostly off screen, so its search box, label options and Show archived labels control cannot be reached or scrolled into view.
reference.expected: The Label filter menu stays within the viewport at 390px, constraining or wrapping long label names, and its search, options and Show archived labels control remain reachable.
reference.actual: With a 50-character label present, opening the Label filter on the repository Issues list at 390px placed the menu at x=-319 with width 403: the search input (x=-307) and the Show archived labels checkbox (x=-308) were off the left edge, and the page could not scroll horizontally to reveal them. With only short labels, or at 412px and wider, the menu opened inside the viewport.
reproSteps: Sign in as eval and create a repository label with a 50-character unbroken name.
Set the viewport to 390×844 and open the repository Issues list.
Observe the menu opening mostly off the left edge, with its search box and Show archived labels control unreachable.
